display_long_description:
Stick Walker VR could be the hardest VR challenge ever created!

In this intense physics-based survival experience, you must learn to walk using only metal sticks while navigating dangerous music-reactive floors, brutal obstacles, moving platforms, and precision balance sections designed to push your coordination to the limit.

There’s one simple rule: DO NOT TOUCH THE FLOOR.

The moment your feet hit the ground, it’s game over.

What starts as a simple movement challenge quickly becomes a true test of skill, balance, timing, endurance, and focus. Every step matters. Every movement can save you or destroy your run. Master advanced stick-walking mechanics, survive increasingly difficult environments, and discover techniques that separate beginners from elite players.

Compete against players worldwide through global leaderboards, improve your times and scores, and prove you can survive longer than anyone else on Quest. Whether you want to challenge your friends, become the number one Stick Walker in the world, or simply experience one of the most unique VR movement systems ever made, this is a game designed to create unforgettable moments, hilarious fails, and intense victories.

Features:

Physics-based stick walking locomotion

Reactive music-driven floors and environments

Instant fail gameplay with high tension

Global leaderboards and score chasing

Increasingly difficult challenge maps

Skill-based movement and balance mechanics

Hardcore gameplay designed for mastery!
